# Forward College

Forward College is an alternative pan-European university founded by Boris Walbaum, Celine Boisson and Jeffrey Sampson in September 2021. It operates campuses in Lisbon, Paris, and Berlin, with students spending one academic year at each campus during their studies. Forward College receives support from investor Xavier Niel, among others.
Accreditation
Forward College offers six bachelor's degrees: Economics, Economics & Politics, International Relations, Data Science & Business Analytics, Business & Management, and Psychology. The curricula are designed by The London School of Economics and King's College London and are accredited by the University of London.
Academic Programmes
Forward College offers three levels of courses:
Bachelor's
The Bachelor's programme enables students to earn a bachelor's degree accredited by the University of London.
Bachelor's +
The Bachelor's + programme allows students to obtain a bachelor's degree accredited by the University of London along with two additional Higher Education certificates.
Double bachelor's
The Double Bachelor's programme combines the University of London's accredited bachelor's degree with Forward College's own bachelor's degree in business and leadership, which includes the equivalent of four Higher Education certificates.
